description: Throughout my service in the Nevada Senate and Assembly, I have worked on and supported legislation that helped create more 21st century jobs, improved our public schools, and defended the voiceless. I am particularly proud of the legislation I sponsored that ensures children with autism can now receive treatment under their health insurance. My work is far from over. I pledge to keep fighting for my district and serving our state.

title: Home - James Ohrenschall | Democrat for Nevada State Senate District 21
